title: Trump Calls A.I. Fears a Hoax. Inside the White House, the Debate Is More Complex.

title: How Trump Became an A.I. Evangelist
partialText: President Trump had little interest in artificial intelligence until a fateful meeting in Las Vegas two years ago. Now, Mr. Trump sees A.I. as the defining technology of our age. Our White House correspondent Jonathan Swan tracks Trump’s journey to A.I. evangelist.

title: Warren Buffett Steps Down as Berkshire Hathaway Chairman
